a.title: Tesla is inviting some people to buy a Cybercab ‘for personal use’ — but read the fine print

b.lede: The electric-auto maker says it has invited some buyers to reserve a personal robotaxi. The arrangement raises big questions about the future of car ownership.
b.title: Tesla’s Cybercab Is the Subscription Hell They Told You Not to Worry About
